winner.title: Sir - Sphere

pass1.summary: Titled "Sir - Sphere" and posted as a sources sought notice, but the text is a purchase request for a De Mayo Adapt2Fit Modular Knee Positioner. The title does not match, and there is no NAICS or PSC code, quantity, or instructions for responding.

issues.why: The posting describes buying an orthopedic knee positioner, while the attachments describe buying Y-90 liver radiation microspheres for Interventional Radiology.

evidence.quote: requests purchase of a De Mayo Adapt2Fit Modular Knee Positioner.
The overall purpose is to acquire the Y-90 microspheres (SIR Spheres) intended for intra-arterial radiation therapy (radioembolization) to liver tumors.

issues.why: The RFI lists questions 3(a) through 3(f) and says there is no page limit on them, but the questions are lettered a, b, c, d, d, e, so the numbering is inconsistent, and the RFI also points to Section 4.1 of a draft SOW for what is being bought.

evidence.quote: There is no page limitation on subparagraphs 3(a) - 3(f).
Please see Section 4.1 in attached Draft Statement of Work

dropped_issues.why: The response deadline is given as October 26, 2026 in the RFI, but the posting data shows October 27, 2026.

evidence.quote: RFI/SS responses are due by 4pm (CST), Monday, October 26, 2026

dropped_issues.reason: a contradiction needs both sides quoted

dropped_issues.why: The statement of work is marked as a draft and contains stray draft characters and sections for equipment acceptance testing, which do not fit a Sources Sought for microspheres; the product specifications section is also vague.

evidence.quote: Shall be provided to preserve continued functions that these treatments provide to the IR department.
The Contractor shall notify the COR in writing that the system is ready for acceptance testing

dropped_issues.reason: verifier: The 'stray draft characters' are the D/R/AF/T letters left when the 'DRAFT' watermark was machine-extracted, which is an extraction artifact. Judging the acceptance-testing sections as misfitting is interpretive, and the claim mixes both points with the vagueness point.

list.title: Replacement of 10 Ton HVAC Unit, Bldg.11, PR ANG

pass1.summary: HVAC replacement RFQ with several internal inconsistencies: it says 'a 10 ton unit' in the title vs 'two 10-ton units' in the text, mentions a different base (Punta Borinquen) in the access notice, mixes time zones (EST/CT/AST), requires a site visit request, and provides a ~12-day window with a 30-day completion. Also references SAM registration that takes 15 business days. A bidder could misprice the quantity.
